card.name: Hyphens in phone and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: Hyphens inside phone numbers and ISBN digits, and punctuation in web-page footer appeals such as 'If this has been helpful, please donate'.

modes.label: Hyphens in number strings
modes.description: The hyphen after the first digits of a toll-free phone number or ISBN.

modes.label: Donation or sharing appeals
modes.description: The comma or 'or' just before a 'please' request at the end of a web page.
